character_types: middle-aged man in glasses and striped pyjama shirt
visual_synopsis: A bespectacled man in a striped pyjama shirt sits at a laid table in a wallpapered apartment, opens a bottle of champagne and drinks and talks with a young woman in purple while a schoolgirl watches from a chair. Outside the door a group of men in dark coats keep wrestling a coffin around the tight corner of the corridor and landing, failing repeatedly, until the man gets up and goes out to the doorway himself.
